dedupe_keys.name: estonia 3d building models lod1 and lod2 land and spatial development board

description: The Estonian Land and Spatial Development Board publishes national 3D data on its Geoportal as part of its Geo3D work, with separate downloads for LOD2 buildings, LOD1 buildings, LOD1-2 roofed areas, LOD1 transport infrastructure and LOD1 greenhouses. The data are free for everyone to use, and users are asked to cite the origin and extraction date, for example Building 3D model data: Republic of Estonia Land and Spatial Development Board 2026. Coverage: Estonia. Access: downloads from the Geoportal page, which sits next to the topographic database, orthophotos, elevation and cadastral data. Licence: Estonian open data terms of use, accepted on download; free. Caveats: the page read lists the products but not their formats, update cycle or attribute schema, which are to be checked in the download files and metadata. Simulation uses are national 3D building geometry for solar, energy, flood and noise modelling and for a national digital twin. Related records: the OGC CityGML standard and other national 3D building models such as 3D BAG and swissBUILDINGS3D.
